column1: # Tools the bootstrap installs into $HOME. Tab-separated so POSIX sh can read it
# with `while IFS="$(printf '\t')" read -r name class version min_glibc source`.
# This file covers only tools that conda-forge cannot supply. Everything else
# comes from `conda-linux-64.lock` via micromamba; see README.md.
# class    how the bootstrap installs it
#   gzbin    gunzip a single binary into ~/.local/bin and chmod +x
#   tarball  extract into ~/.local/opt/<arch>-glibc<ver>/, symlink the bin/ entries
#   installer  run the upstream install command; the tool updates itself thereafter
#   pip      pip install --user
#   fontarchive  extract the *NLNerdFontMono* styles into ~/.local/share/fonts,
#                then fc-cache -f. That path needs no root and works everywhere;
#                the laptop's copy currently sits in /usr/share/fonts instead.
# min_glibc  the oldest glibc the published artifact runs against, measured with
#            `objdump -T <binary> | grep -o 'GLIBC_2\.[0-9]*' | sort -V | tail -1`.
#            A row whose min_glibc exceeds the host's cannot be used there.
#            "any" means no glibc version references at all.
# name
nvim
micromamba
trash-cli
claude
nerd-font
